bins.description: An integer representing the number of histogram bins. Defaults to 10.
constraints: An integer representing the number of histogram bins.

range.description: A tuple representing the lower and upper range of the bins. If not specified, it will use the min and max of `x`.
constraints: If specified, must be a tuple with two elements.

output.description: A tuple containing: - A tensor representing the counts of elements in each bin. - A tensor representing the bin edges.

constraints: The output tuple must have exactly two tensors.
